senses.gloss: untilled ground surrounding the vineyard (between the vines and the fence).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 4:1">Kil. IV, 1</cite>, sq. <he>מְחוֹל הכרם</he>; <cite ref="Eruvin 3b:18">Erub. 3ᵇ</cite>.
Y. Kil. IV, 29ᵇ top ולא מ׳ לכרם קטן nor does the law concerning the planting of the maḥol apply to a small vineyard.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 4:1:7">Ib.</cite> <he>יש לו מ׳</he> the law does apply to it.
Ib. ניטל המ׳ (prob. to be read בטל) it has no more the nature of a maḥol
<cite ref="Taanit 31a:9">Taan. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>לעשות מ׳</he> to arrange a chorus.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 294">Yalk. Is. 294</cite>, v. <cite ref="H00335"><he>חוֹלָה</he> II</cite>.
